title: No set meets every line of the k × k torus exactly twice when 3 divides k
summary: Ku's restated Conjecture 5.1: no set meets every row, column and diagonal of the k × k torus exactly twice when 3 | k.
source: K.-H. Ku, "Monochromatic k in a row", arXiv:2606.12880v1 (June 2026), the restatement of Conjecture 5.1.
label: lean
first_by: A proof in words in `the-omega-institute/trureturing`, 4 November 2026. The proof here is the first machine-checked one known to this repository.
